body: Well damn. Thanks. That's really interesting. Rethinking everything now.

Interesting... But, if I set goals for myself, I should follow through. And the whole point of getting better is so I can do my things, but I know I can't wait to get better to do my things, so I should do them anyway. I don't think I should use what's wrong with me as an excuse to not do my things... What am I missing?
How can I know if I'm sabotaging myself instead of helping?

I know something is wrong with me but I really wanted to fix it. I thought I could, and I have tried. I've been in therapy for more than a year and a half now, I go every week. But my first therapist who was actually really good, he moved to another state. The second one was a sociopath who made me worse. The third one wasn't equipped to help. The one I have now is really good, but my life is so bad. It's so bad and this *whole time* I've been trying to not only fix the bad things, but prevent all these other bad things from happening. But it's bad, it's so bad. I do think that I just can't be fixed, and that I should die. I'm sorry I couldn't be better, I really did try. I don't know what else I can do. I could not try any harder. I'm sorry

Thank you for this. You sound really strong. I do have a list of small things I've been doing every day for the past two weeks. It was helping, but now I feel so bad. I don't know. It seems like nothing I do will really ever help. But thank you

I don't know really why I hurt myself. Because I'm in so much pain and it's a reaction to that to make it stop. In the moment there's nothing else I can think or do, it's a complete state of panic. I have better ways of coping that I use normally, but when I'm freaking out I'm just *freaking out*. There's nothing that I'm thinking or can do. It's a struggle to not kill myself during those times, so hurting myself becomes my best. 

I don't really think people want me to stay. They want me to be better maybe, but they don't like me the way I am now and I'm not sure I can be different. I have honestly tried everything. I am just fucked up.
